title.text: v1 · approval model (superseded by v2 below) · sample data

n_cc.text: Command Centre · Product: the "Needs you" queue comes first, briefing covers holdings only, 3 pre-checked candidates. Design: AI rail shown expanded (it remembers its state), so the nav collapses to icons. The AI commits to a call with a kill condition and a counter-argument; confidence in words, never a %.

n_rs.text: Discover & Research · Portfolio fit is the first tab: headroom under the 10%/30% caps plus one correlation number (warn > 0.7). The DCF shows "not meaningful" when FCF is negative. Evidence: wire repeats collapse into "n outlets · headline match". Stale tactical inputs show "Refresh and continue".

n_pf.text: My Portfolio · Holdings table has 8 columns, so it fits at 1440 without horizontal scroll. Qty, cost and $ price are in the row expansion; FX effect is a second line under Total P&L. Agents can only SUGGEST a thesis status; the user confirms. A price drop never invalidates a thesis.

n_ta.text: Trade approval · Every number is calculated by Python; the gate verdict comes before the AI's opinion. Approve never moves and has no hotkey. Use Tweaks → Approval state to see warning / clean / hard fail / expired / staged. Size bound by the 10% position cap: 163, not 178.

n_ta2.text: Staged (out-of-hours) approvals are conditional: limits, not an order. Fire time comes from Alpaca's calendar (open + 5 min), never hard-coded. Sized at max entry (1.005 × P) → 160 shares, max loss $497.60. Nothing reaches Alpaca out of hours.

title_v2.text: v2 · autonomous paper day-trader · no approvals (sample data, $5,000 Balanced)

n_v2_on.text: Onboarding · 4 steps: amount, level, contract, start. The level cards show only the loss cap (a rule) until the M0 replay gives real good-day numbers: no invented forecasts. Start is enabled only after the contract checkbox.

n_v2_live.text: Live · pot after costs vs SPY-scaled and cash, worse of shadow and broker ledgers. Honest: today it's behind SPY. Evidence counter stays grey ('can only kill') below 900 trades. Shadow strategies are hatched and never summed into the pot. Pause and Flatten-and-stop work; try them.

n_v2_td.text: Trade detail · 'Why' in plain language first, then the Python gate checks, the agent-room transcript (Proposer solid, Critic dashed, Judge double rule, then Python's outcome), and broker vs shadow fills. On $5,000 the 15% position cap binds: 1.81 fractional shares.

title_v3.text: v3 · dark theme · same screens plus Report, Engine health, Run & settings (sample data: $5,000 Hunter run)

n_v3_motion.text: v3 · responsive + motion. Every screen is fluid: under 760 px the top nav becomes a bottom tab bar, cards stack, the big numbers shrink, and wide detail (stop/target bars, reasons) hides instead of squeezing. Motion: cards rise in with a short stagger, chart lines draw in, range changes morph the line, buttons press, the live dot pulses, tabs and confirms slide in. All of it stops for 'reduce motion'. Press Play on any v3 screen and resize the window to try it.

title_m5.text: M5 proposal · configuration panel (after M4 · pending product-owner approval) · sample data: $5,000 Hunter

n_m5.text: Strategy v3, from research on Wealthfront, Betterment, Pionex, 3Commas, Composer, eToro and Robinhood. Lazy path: tap a 'Start from' preset card (each shows trades/month and max loss), then Review & apply. That's 2 taps. Curious path: four cards on one screen. Focus has theme cards with logo stacks and per-theme trade rates, Prefer/Only, and Exclude a stock. Boldness is one 5-step bar that sets all six risk limits within Hunter, with $ results underneath. Trading hours are shapes you tap, and the day bar redraws. Extra caution is three pill switches. The outcome bar stays pinned at the bottom. Power path: Fine-tune all settings (09b) keeps every row and slider, so no feature is lost.

n_m5b.text: Quant caveat shown on purpose: Hyperscalers + Semiconductors (11 stocks) ≈ 10 trades/month vs ≈ 45 on all 59. The 900-trade go-live bar would take ~8 years at that pace. Try Prefer these, or add themes, and watch the estimate move.

n_m5_10_wait.text: Awaiting stakeholder approval before Frontend builds board 10

n_m5_10.text: My lists (issue #97). Press Play: the four sample tickers are checked one by one (shimmer), then NBIS, CRWV and FSLY are accepted and ZZZT, a made-up ticker, is refused as “not tradable at the broker”. With 3 accepted, “Only these” shows the at-least-5 warning and Review & apply stays off. Type or paste MSFT, AMD to reach 5. Other made-up samples: ZZZV trades too little, ZZZP price under $5, ZZZH too little history. Saving keeps only accepted tickers. The counter stops at 40. Trades a month reads “not measured yet” while any ticker is new; the saved “Cloud & chips” list shows a measured figure. Tweaks: hold the checking state, show the loading skeleton.

n_ds_diff.text:
Design system (issue #79) · where apps/web/src/tokens.css and app.css differ from the boards. Facts only.
1. The 12 colour values match tokens.css. Names differ: bg is --paper, text is --ink / --slate / --stale, accent is --sea, SPY is --s-spy.
2. Warn tint: --warn-tint is #33280F; boards use #33270F in 3 places and #33280F in 1.
3. Selected tint: --sea-tint is #132A4A; boards use #16263D for selected cards (12 places). app.css hard-codes #16263D 5 times in the Strategy block.
4. Hero number: app.css .hero is 60 px (42 px on phones); the Home board is 64 px (44 px).
5. Card padding: app.css .card is 22 px; boards use 22 px on 26 cards, 24 px on 4, 20 px on 3.
6. Skeleton: app.css .sk has no radius and turns flat #1B1E24 under reduce-motion; boards give .sk a 10 px radius and only stop the shimmer.
7. Bar grow: app 0.9 s after 0.25 s; boards 0.8 s after 0.3 s. Chart rise delay: app 0.2 s; boards 0.15 s.
8. Boards' shared CSS still has an unused line draw-in rule (.draw, 1.3 s); app.css has none.
9. Top bar: app is sticky with blur, padding 14 × 24 px; boards are static, 16 × 40 px.
10. Page width: app main is 1320 px on every page (Strategy 1120); boards use 1320 Home, 1240 Report / Engine / Trade detail, 1040 Run & settings, 1120 Strategy.
11. PAPER pill weight: app 700; boards 600.
12. Agent room: app.css .room-role and .evlist li have a 4 px radius and a 3 px coloured left border; no v3 board uses a coloured left border.
13. Text inputs: app is 48 px high with a 14 px radius; boards use a 42–44 px pill field (app .kb-search matches the boards).
14. --ai is #C9B6FF; the boards' badge palette uses #C9A8FF.
15. Boards 09 and 09b use the .sk skeleton class but their CSS does not define it, so their loading state is blank on the canvas.
